responsibility: Defines the standard typedefs and convenience macros for GCC’s polynomial integer ecosystem, including poly_int and poly_int_pod specializations for host, offset, wide_int, and widest_int coefficient types. It also provides common bit/byte alignment, vector-element sizing, unroll-factor, and target-macro compatibility helpers that let the rest of GCC manipulate compile-time-or-runtime-dependent sizes using concise module-wide aliases.
